limits: Five exact selected libc imports; not all 88 SQLite provider contracts
Ordinary captured Linux x64 scalar/pointer loader signatures only
Selected registered loader/error addresses share the proven provider contract; no arbitrary loader interposition
Read-clear preserves returned bytes until next selected loader call; native pthread destructor owns cleanup
This fixture does not prove incoming raw loader-error state from arbitrary foreign native application bodies
No SQLite execution, native extension algorithm fallback, cancellation or native C++ exception propagation claim

publicUseAudit.scope: unixDlError casts dlerror result to local const-byte pointer, tests it, then passes it to translated sqlite3_snprintf before leaving mutex; no general alias-analysis claim

oracle.role: Independent native application oracle; never generated dependency

zeroSymbolProvider.role: ABI-only absolute NULL-valued symbol; no executable native application body

interferenceHelper.role: Checker-only raw loader interference; no application binding

nativeImports.providerContract: explicit native ABI bindings; no native application bodies

generatedAbi.contract: concrete SysV AMD64 ABI forwarding only; application bodies remain C#

logicalErrno.addressContract: native thread-local application slot; distinct from raw libc errno; coherent direct/indirect/address-exposed entry

logicalDlerror.pendingContract: each selected loader call replaces pending error, including success clearing; NULL result alone is not error
logicalDlerror.storageContract: native per-thread owned byte snapshot; read-clear keeps returned buffer alive until next selected loader call; pthread destructor releases storage

emission.rawErrorProvider: registered explicitly bound address; no linked-name fallback
